data.title: UNIONS NEEDED NOW MORE THAN EVER
data.description: In Edmonton, Alberta, CUPE Alberta President Raj Uppal emphasized the crucial need for robust unions in light of recent attacks on workers. Uppal highlighted the significance of Labour Day as a time to honor and recognize the contributions of working individuals who drive the province forward. Referring to the impactful one-day strike at WestJet last month, Uppal emphasized the power of united workers in accomplishing goals. He criticized corporations for exploiting workers while amassing record profits. The statement resonates as workers across Alberta face challenges, underscoring the importance of solidarity and organized labor in protecting worker rights and advancing fair treatment.

data.title: OpenReserve, supported by a16z, is approved as a full-service national bank, opting for insured deposits and conventional lending.
data.description: The startup, supported by a16z, decided to pursue a full national charter rather than opting for the trust-bank approach commonly chosen by many crypto companies. This decision enables them to offer insured deposits, traditional lending services, and the ability to issue stablecoins in the market.

data.title: QuFi debuts verification platform using post-quantum cryptography for Bitcoin testnet proof, no changes needed for blockchain networks.
data.description: QuFi has introduced a new platform that leverages post-quantum cryptography to authenticate digital asset transactions seamlessly within current blockchain settlement networks. This innovative technology ensures secure verification processes without the need for modifications to the existing infrastructure, promising enhanced security and efficiency in the blockchain ecosystem. With burgeoning concerns over cybersecurity and data protection, the incorporation of post-quantum cryptography in QuFi's platform offers a robust solution to safeguarding transactions. This advancement signifies a significant step towards ensuring the integrity and confidentiality of digital assets in the evolving landscape of blockchain technology.

data.title: Pathlock Recognized as a Representative Vendor in the 2026 Gartner® Market Guide for Identity Governance and Administration

data.title: Leverage Shares Files for 2x Long and 2x Short Anthropic ETFs -- ANUU, ANDD and ANSS -- Ahead of the Anthropic IPO
data.description: Anthropic, a company based in Greenwich, Connecticut, is set to go public on September 4, 2026. In preparation for this event, Leverage Shares by Themes is planning to launch three new Anthropic leveraged ETFs. These ETFs will offer active traders daily exposure to Anthropic common stock in different multiples: 2x long, 2x short, and 1x short. This will provide traders with the opportunity to capitalize on movements in the stock price, whether bullish or bearish, with increased leverage.

data.title: A&S Resources secures railway funding of USD$6 Billion to unlock $2.5 trillion iron ore asset
data.description: The funding for the railway connecting A&S Resources Limited's mineral assets in the Central African Republic (CAR) through Cameroon to global export markets has been secured in London on September 4, 2026. This development signifies a notable advancement in unlocking one of the planet's most extensive mineral reserves.

data.title: SDK.finance Launches a Real-Time General Ledger for Banks and FinTech Companies
data.description: In Lithuania's capital city of Vilnius on September 4th, 2026, SDK.finance introduced an event-driven, double-entry accounting layer. This innovative technology seamlessly converts financial product events into balanced and auditable journal entries. Businesses can integrate this layer without having to replace their current transaction platform. This marks a significant step forward in financial software development and offers companies the ability to enhance their accounting processes.
